KOTHRUD POLICE STATION, PUNE CITY POLICE

FIRST INFORMATION REPORT AND SPOT PANCHANAMA (ROAD ACCIDENT)

Field | Detail
FIR No. | 0287/2026
Police Station | Kothrud Police Station, Pune City
Date of incident | Friday, 14 August 2026
Time of incident | Reported as about 22:15 hrs (see note 1)
Place of incident | Sahyadri Chowk, the four-way junction of Karve Road (east-west) and Lane 7 (north-south), Kothrud, Pune. Approx. 18.5058 N, 73.8083 E
Sections invoked | BNS 281 (rash driving), BNS 125(b) (act endangering life causing grievous hurt); MV Act 119/177 (disobeying a traffic signal) and 184 (dangerous driving)
Investigating Officer | PSI Anil Pawar, Kothrud Police Station
Informant | Pradeep Shinde, 47, owner of Shinde Tea Stall, Karve Road, Sahyadri Chowk (north-west corner)

1. Information received

At 22:14 hrs on 14 August 2026 a 112 emergency call was logged by the Pune control room reporting a collision between a car and an auto-rickshaw at Sahyadri Chowk. PCR Van Kothrud-3 was dispatched and reached the spot at 22:21 hrs. PSI Anil Pawar took over the scene at 22:34 hrs.

Note 1: The time of "about 22:15 hrs" is the time the informant estimated when he gave his statement. The signal controller log and the junction CCTV (see separate exhibits) fix the collision itself at 22:13:49 hrs. The FIR time is therefore the time the matter was reported, not the time of impact.

2. Vehicles involved

1. Vehicle A: White Honda City sedan, registration MH12 KE 4417, registered to Menon Analytics Pvt. Ltd., Baner, Pune. Driven by Rajesh Menon, 41, of Flat 402, Sai Heights, Kothrud. The vehicle was travelling eastbound on Karve Road, from the Deccan side towards the Paud Road side.
2. Vehicle B: CNG auto-rickshaw (three-wheeler), registration MH12 QR 2208, black and yellow, owner-driver Santosh Jadhav, 52, of Bhusari Colony, Kothrud. It was travelling southbound on Lane 7 with one passenger, Meera Kulkarni, 34, a school teacher of Mayur Colony.
3. Vehicle C (not involved in the collision): Honda Activa scooter, registration MH12 ZB 9031, ridden by Neha Bhosale, 29. Ms Bhosale was behind Vehicle A on Karve Road and stopped after the collision.

3. Road and junction description

- Karve Road runs east-west. It has one lane each way, each 3.5 m wide, separated by a painted double white centre line. Traffic keeps to the left.
- Lane 7 meets Karve Road at right angles from the north and from the south. It has one lane each way, each 3.5 m wide.
- The junction is controlled by a four-phase traffic signal (controller ID J-17-09). Stop lines are painted about 8 m from the centre of the junction on all four arms.
- The posted speed limit on Karve Road is 40 km/h. The posted limit on Lane 7 is 30 km/h.
- Road surface: dry asphalt, no potholes. Street lighting (sodium lamps) working on all four corners. Weather: clear, 27 degrees C.
- A bus shelter stands at the north-west corner. Shinde Tea Stall stands beside it. A pharmacy occupies the south-east corner.

4. Scene survey (total station)

All coordinates below are in metres east (E) and north (N) of the centre of the junction, taken as the point where the Karve Road centre line meets the Lane 7 centre line. Headings are compass bearings (0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west).

Item | Position E, N (m) | Remarks
Point of impact (debris cluster centre, glass and plastic fragments) | +1.6, +1.7 | Inside the junction, in the north-east quarter
Start of sedan skid marks (left front tyre) | -11.8, +1.75 | Two parallel dark skid marks laid by the sedan, heading east
End of sedan skid marks | +1.6, +1.75 | Marks end at the point of impact. Total measured length 13.4 m
Honda City MH12 KE 4417, final rest, centre of vehicle | +4.2, +2.5 | Facing 95 degrees (roughly east), front bumper and right headlamp damaged
Auto-rickshaw MH12 QR 2208, final rest, centre of vehicle | +5.8, -0.9 | Lying on its left side, facing about 245 degrees (roughly south-west), canopy crushed on the right side
Debris field | +1.0 to +6.0 east, -1.0 to +3.0 north | Broken headlamp lens, bumper clips, auto canopy fragments, glass
Passenger's handbag and phone | +3.4, -0.2 | Thrown clear of the auto
Fluid trace (coolant/CNG regulator oil) | +4.0, +2.0 | Beneath the sedan's front
Karve Road west approach stop line | -8.0, +1.75 | Eastbound
Lane 7 north approach stop line | +1.75, +8.0 | Southbound
CCTV pole KR-CAM-07 (west approach) | -62.0, +4.0 | Faces east along Karve Road
CCTV pole KR-CAM-09 (north-east corner) | +6.0, +6.0 | Faces the junction, south-west
Traffic signal controller cabinet | -5.0, -5.0 | South-west corner
Shinde Tea Stall (witness position) | -6.0, +7.0 | North-west corner, about 9 m from the point of impact

5. Scene findings

1. The sedan's skid marks run in a straight line along the eastbound lane and end at the point of impact. No skid marks were found from the auto-rickshaw.
2. The sedan's damage is to the front bumper and front right corner. The auto-rickshaw's damage is to the right (west) side, which faced the sedan.
3. The sedan's airbags did not deploy. The auto-rickshaw has no airbags.
4. The auto-rickshaw was lifted and rolled onto its left side. The passenger was thrown out of the auto's open right side and came to rest on the road at the position of the handbag.
5. No brake fluid or other mechanical failure was apparent at the scene. Detailed vehicle inspection has been requested from the RTO (see MVI report).

6. Persons injured

1. Meera Kulkarni (auto passenger): conscious, bleeding from the forehead, complaining of pain in the left shoulder and right chest. Shifted by ambulance to Sahyadri Hospital, Kothrud.
2. Santosh Jadhav (auto driver): conscious, complaining of severe pain in the left leg. Shifted by the same ambulance.
3. Rajesh Menon (car driver): walking, complaining of chest discomfort from the seat belt. Examined at the same hospital and released after treatment.

7. Action taken

- Both vehicles seized under Section 106 BNSS and stored at Kothrud Police Station yard.
- Breath analyser test conducted on Mr Menon at the hospital (result in a separate exhibit).
- Mr Menon's mobile phone seized for call detail records.
- Request sent to Pune Municipal Corporation Traffic Signal Cell for the controller log, and to the Traffic Branch for CCTV footage from KR-CAM-07 and KR-CAM-09.
- Request sent to the RTO for a Motor Vehicle Inspector's report on both vehicles.

Signed: PSI Anil Pawar, Kothrud Police Station. Panch witnesses: Dinesh Gaikwad and Sunil Dhumal.

evidence.title: Statement: Rajesh Menon (sedan driver)
evidence.description: Driver of the Honda City, recorded at Kothrud Police Station.
evidence.summary: Says the signal was amber, he drove at about 40 km/h, was alone, and his phone was on Bluetooth. Describes the car as silver-grey and says he left the office at about 21:55.
evidence.extracted_text:
STATEMENT OF RAJESH MENON (CAR DRIVER)

Recorded at: Kothrud Police Station, Pune
Date and time recorded: 15 August 2026, 11:20 hrs
Recorded by: PSI Anil Pawar
Language: Marathi/English, written down in English

I, Rajesh Menon, aged 41 years, a senior manager at Menon Analytics Pvt. Ltd., residing at Flat 402, Sai Heights, Kothrud, Pune, state as follows.

On the night of 14 August 2026 I was driving home from my office in Baner in my company car, a silver-grey Honda City, registration MH12 KE 4417. I was alone in the car. I left the office at about 21:55 and took Karve Road towards Kothrud.

I was driving at about 40 kilometres per hour, which is the limit on that road. I always keep to the limit because the road is busy with scooters. I was in the left lane going east. Nobody was in front of me at the junction.

As I came near Sahyadri Chowk the signal was amber when I was still some distance away. I did not think I could stop safely, so I continued. I am sure the light was amber and had not turned red when I went over the line. I do not remember any other vehicle coming from the side road. Suddenly an auto-rickshaw appeared from my left. I think it was not slowing down and I believe the driver was in a hurry. I applied the brakes with all my strength but I could not avoid the collision. My front right side hit the auto.

At the time of the accident I was not using my mobile phone. I may have received a call just before, but my phone was connected to the car's Bluetooth and I was not holding it. I do not remember how long the call lasted.

I have not consumed any alcohol that evening. I had a glass of wine at a client dinner at about 20:00 hrs but nothing after that. I agreed to give a breath sample.

After the accident I got out of the car and went to the auto-rickshaw. I helped the driver. I did not run away. I called for help. I stayed at the spot until the police arrived. I did not speak to any woman who was in my car, because as I said I was alone.

I request the police to check the signal log, as I am sure it was amber for me. I am willing to cooperate with the investigation.

The above statement was read over to me in English and I confirm that it is true.

Signature: Rajesh Menon

evidence.title: Statement: Santosh Jadhav (auto-rickshaw driver)
evidence.description: Owner-driver of the auto-rickshaw, recorded at his hospital bedside.
evidence.summary: Says he moved off when his light turned green, at low speed, and a white Honda City came fast from his right. Says the car driver was alone.
evidence.extracted_text:
STATEMENT OF SANTOSH JADHAV (AUTO-RICKSHAW DRIVER)

Recorded at: Sahyadri Hospital, Kothrud, Pune (bedside, ward 2)
Date and time recorded: 15 August 2026, 09:40 hrs
Recorded by: PSI Anil Pawar. Dr Kavita Rao confirmed the patient was fit to give a statement.
Language: Marathi, translated into English by Constable Savita More

My name is Santosh Jadhav. I am 52 years old and I live in Bhusari Colony, Kothrud. I have driven my own CNG auto-rickshaw, MH12 QR 2208, for 17 years and I have a valid badge and licence.

On the night of 14 August at about 22:10 I picked up one lady passenger, Meera madam, near the Mayur Colony bus stop. She asked me to go to Bhusari Colony. I took Lane 7 going south towards Karve Road. She was sitting in the back seat and she had her handbag with her.

When I reached Sahyadri Chowk the signal for me was red. I slowed down and I was moving very slowly, about 15 to 20 kilometres per hour, towards the line, as the signal was about to change. I was not stopping completely because I saw the cross-traffic signal had finished. When my light turned green I went forward. I had crossed the stop line when I saw a car coming very fast from my right, from the Deccan side, along Karve Road. I could hear the engine. I did not hear the horn. I tried to turn the handle to the left but the car hit my auto from the right side. The auto was lifted and fell on its left side. I fell with my left leg under the auto and I felt severe pain. I do not remember what happened to the passenger. I saw her lying on the road when I got out.

The car was white, I am certain, a Honda City. The man who got out of the car was alone. A woman did not come with him. I do not know of any woman who got out of that car.

I was not on my phone. I do not use my phone while driving. I had not drunk any alcohol. I do not drink on duty.

I want to complain against the car driver. He was driving very fast and he jumped the red light.

evidence.title: Statement: Pradeep Shinde (eyewitness, informant)
evidence.description: Tea stall owner at the north-west corner.
evidence.summary: Karve Road was red some seconds before; the white Honda City came very fast (60 or 70). A young woman in a blue kurta got out of the front passenger seat and left. Called 112.
evidence.extracted_text:
STATEMENT OF PRADEEP SHINDE (INDEPENDENT EYEWITNESS AND INFORMANT)

Recorded at: Shinde Tea Stall, Sahyadri Chowk
Date and time recorded: 14 August 2026, 23:05 hrs
Recorded by: PSI Anil Pawar
Language: Marathi, translated into English

My name is Pradeep Shinde, age 47. I run Shinde Tea Stall at the north-west corner of Sahyadri Chowk. I have been here for 12 years and I know this signal well. I keep the stall open until about 23:30 every night.

Tonight at about ten fifteen (I am not looking at the clock, it was about 10:15) I was pouring tea for a customer when I heard a very loud screeching of tyres and then a crash. I looked up. The signal for Karve Road, the east-west road, had turned red some seconds before. I remember that the green arrow for the side road had just come on because the cars on Lane 7 had started to move. The white Honda City was coming from the Deccan side, very fast, much faster than the other cars on that road. I think it was going sixty or seventy, I cannot say exactly. It did not slow down until the last moment. The auto-rickshaw was coming from the Lane 7 side, from the north, and it was going slowly, like any auto in the city.

The car hit the auto on its side and the auto flipped over. There was glass everywhere. A woman, the passenger of the auto, was thrown out onto the road. She was bleeding.

The car stopped a little further ahead. The driver got out. He looked very shaken. He was on his phone, I think, because he was holding it to his ear and talking while he walked. I am not sure if he was calling someone or someone had called him.

I also saw a young woman get out of the front passenger seat of the white car. She was wearing a blue kurta. She stood there for a short while, speaking to the driver. Then she went away on foot towards the Paud Road side. A few minutes later she got into a passing auto-rickshaw and left. This was before the police van reached the spot. I did not see her again. I can say I saw this clearly because the street lamp is right there.

I called 112 from my mobile at once and I gave the details. I also called the ambulance number. People from the pharmacy came to help the injured woman.

I did not know any of these people before tonight.

Signature: Pradeep Shinde

evidence.description: Rode behind the sedan on Karve Road.

STATEMENT OF NEHA BHOSALE (SCOOTER RIDER, WITNESS)

Recorded at: Kothrud Police Station
Date and time recorded: 15 August 2026, 14:00 hrs
Recorded by: PSI Anil Pawar

I am Neha Bhosale, 29 years old, working as a physiotherapist at a clinic on Karve Road. I ride a Honda Activa, MH12 ZB 9031.

On 14 August at around 22:13 I was riding home along Karve Road, going east towards Kothrud. I was in the left lane at about 30 kilometres per hour. About 150 metres before Sahyadri Chowk a car came up behind me and overtook me on the right, crossing the double line in the middle of the road. Conscious, oriented. Pulse 112 per minute, blood pressure 108/70 mmHg, respiratory rate 24 per minute, oxygen saturation 94 percent on room air. No loss of consciousness was reported by the patient; the bystanders at the scene could not say.

2. Injuries found

1. Head: A 5 cm lacerated wound over the forehead, on the right side, with underlying tenderness. CT head shows a linear, undisplaced fracture of the frontal bone on the right side. No intracranial bleed seen. Brain parenchyma appears normal on the scan.

5. Abdomen: Soft, non-tender. Ultrasound (FAST) shows no free fluid. The liver, spleen and kidneys appear normal on ultrasound.
6. Spine and pelvis: No tenderness; X-rays normal.
7. Right knee: Abrasion of 3 cm by 3 cm.

Wound sutured (8 stitches) and dressed. Left arm in a sling for the clavicle fracture, to be reviewed by orthopaedics. Oxygen by mask for 6 hours. Admitted under the surgical team for observation.

The injuries are consistent with a person being thrown from a vehicle in a road traffic accident. The fractures of the frontal bone, left clavicle and right ribs are grievous in nature (fracture of bone). The patient is out of danger at the time of reporting but remains under observation for the lung contusion for 48 hours.

ai_insights: FIR 0287/2026 and spot panchanama: Sedan MH12 KE 4417 eastbound on Karve Road and auto-rickshaw MH12 QR 2208 southbound on Lane 7 collided at Sahyadri Chowk. Sedan skid marks 13.4 m ending at the point of impact (+1.6 E, +1.7 N). The auto came to rest on its left side. Passenger thrown out. FIR time 'about 22:15' is the reporting time.

Statement: Rajesh Menon (sedan driver): Says the signal was amber, he drove at about 40 km/h, was alone, and his phone was on Bluetooth. Describes the car as silver-grey and says he left the office at about 21:55.
Statement: Santosh Jadhav (auto-rickshaw driver): Says he moved off when his light turned green, at low speed, and a white Honda City came fast from his right. Says the car driver was alone.

Statement: Pradeep Shinde (eyewitness, informant): Karve Road was red some seconds before; the white Honda City came very fast (60 or 70). A young woman in a blue kurta got out of the front passenger seat and left. Called 112.

Statement: Neha Bhosale (scooter rider): The sedan overtook her across the double line about 150 m before the junction at 60 km/h or more, with the Karve Road signal red. Saw the driver's face lit by a screen.
Signal controller log, junction J-17-09: Karve Road amber 22:13:41, red 22:13:44; Lane 7 green 22:13:47. At the 22:13:49 collision Karve Road had been red for 5 s and Lane 7 green for 2 s. No faults.

CCTV analysis, cameras KR-CAM-07 and KR-CAM-09: Sedan at about 65 km/h crosses the stop line 4.7 s into its red; auto crosses on green at 17 km/h; impact 22:13:49.4. Two people leave the sedan; the person in blue leaves the scene at 22:16:35.

Event data recorder, Honda City MH12 KE 4417: 66 km/h until 1.0 s before impact, brake 0.9 s before, no evasive steering. Front passenger seat occupied and belted. Call on the phone's own speaker, not the car's hands-free.
Emergency call 112 (transcript): Caller reports a white Honda City came through the red light, an injured woman on the road and the auto driver trapped; a girl got out of the car and is leaving.
Medico-legal report: Meera Kulkarni: Frontal bone fracture with forehead laceration, displaced left clavicle fracture, right 4th to 6th rib fractures with right lung contusion, abrasions. Grievous.

Medico-legal reports: Santosh Jadhav and Rajesh Menon: Jadhav: displaced fracture of the left tibia and fibula, no alcohol. Menon: seat-belt bruise, breath alcohol 18 mg per 100 ml (limit 30), discharged.

Motor vehicle inspection, both vehicles: Both vehicles mechanically sound. Sedan is white (Arctic White), damage at the front right corner; auto crushed on its right side. Phone holder on the sedan's dashboard.
Call detail records: Rajesh Menon: Call home at 21:47 ('left office'). Incoming call from Priya Nair answered at 22:12:58 and in progress at impact; ended 22:14:39.
